scope: Grow payment integration (real pay.grow.link URLs) + order-flow.js localStorage-as-source-of-truth on static Grow redirect
automated_coverage_details: order-flow.js logic verified via browser eval assertion harness (Formspree stubbed via --init-script fetch override, no real submissions): startPayment persists sd_pending_order for vip (price 870) and regular (price 450) with order_number + photo_gallery carried; paymentUrlFor routes each package to its exact real pay.grow.link URL; initThankYou resolves order id from localStorage when URL lacks ?order; Purchase pixel guarded once (value 870, purchaseFired flag); Formspree delivery success clears pending, failure keeps pending + shows retry, retry recovers; lost fallback + correct mailto when no pending.
browser_test_details: Headless Chromium via agent-browser on local http server. VIP+regular submit -> correct real Grow Document URLs returned HTTP 200 with appended ?order=<id> (page rendered, Google Pay payframe loaded, proving param harmless). thank-you.html?paid=1&pkg=vip (incl. &response=success): paid UI 'הרכישה הושלמה' + order number shown, sendOk, pending cleared, Purchase pixel fired (fbevents.js 200, value 870). Failure path: sendFail + retry + order retained; retry -> sendOk + cleared. No-pending -> lost fallback + mailto baritzy@gmail.com. Index pending banner shows order + names, resume-pay navigates to correct Grow URL. 7 screenshots in ../temp/grow-qa/.
known_flags: Real Grow payment cannot be completed in automated QA (needs a live transaction). Grow's success redirect is STATIC and does not carry the order id; localStorage is the source of truth. On refresh AFTER a successful delivery (pending already cleared, URL has no ?order) the page shows the 'order lost / email us' fallback rather than the delivered-OK state; it does NOT resend to Formspree and does NOT re-fire the pixel. Pending real-transaction verification: that Grow preserves our ?paid=1&pkg=... query string on redirect.
